attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole notice of him is one sentence. There is no country, no century, no emperor, no year and no hymn. The three men of this name the corpus already keeps are on other days and the page says nothing that would join him to any of them; the folder is marked by its day. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
